CREATE VIEW site_esi AS
SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.zonelabel,
    s.digunit,
    s.gridtrace,
    s.geox,
    s.geoy,
    s.heightm,
    s.depthc,
    s.phasefactor,
    s.guessdate,
    s.typesite,
    s.presstat,
    s.guardhint,
    s.entrystat,
    s.saferank,
    s.insurstat,
    s.riskeval,
    s.healtheval,
    s.envhaz,
    ROUND(
        100.0 
        - 2.5 * ABS(se.ambictemp - 20) 
        - POWER(ABS(se.humepct - 50) / 2.0, 1.5) 
        - 600.0 / (se.illumelux + 100),
        4
    ) AS esi
FROM sites s
JOIN scanenvironment se ON s.zoneregistry = se.zoneref;
